answer: A basalt of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
